title: ui: Console MCP skill mirror should teach delete_record confirm: true (after #30813)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czvZykUqhYxYXSSDt4

Follow-up from card #30813 (PR #30861, BREAKING). After that PR, MCP `delete_record` refuses any call without `confirm: true` and answers `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Stale text:** `ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.ts` is the Console's mirror of the MCP-served SKILL.md. Three places still teach `delete_record({ objectName, recordId })` with no `confirm`: L98, L109 and L117. The mirror has also drifted in other ways: it lacks `run_action`, which the server-side `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` teaches.

**Expected:** the mirror teaches what `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` serves, `confirm: true` on `delete_record` included. A shared source or a drift pin would keep the two together.

**Serial:** after PR #30861 merges. Suggested grade p3.
